reviewer: Independent senior engineer (identity pending release record)

findings.title: Entity search disclosed inaccessible organizations and client contacts
findings.disposition: Entity discovery now intersects supported record classes, governing view permissions, accessible organizations, person associations, and actor-bound RLS anchor policies.

findings.title: Organizations were open to all authorized staff by default
findings.disposition: New organizations now default to assigned-only access; the creation UI states the fail-closed behavior and owners retain break-glass access.

findings.title: Blank entity search bypassed record-class permissions
findings.disposition: All discovery paths are constrained server-side to the explicit searchable catalog and each type's governing read permission; mention filters use the same bounded choices.

findings.title: Authorization requests were not exercised through the runtime database role
findings.disposition: A dedicated Django request regression reconnects as the non-superuser runtime role and drives entity search and mention isolation through middleware, policy, ORM, and PostgreSQL RLS.

findings.title: Publication verification lacks an operator trust anchor
findings.disposition: Assigned to 0.9.5 external-review remediation: pin current and retired publication-key fingerprints and reject self-asserted keys.

findings.title: Outbound webhook HTTP occurs inside a database transaction
findings.disposition: Assigned to 0.9.1 beta defect triage: commit the delivery lease before network I/O and record the outcome in a second short transaction.

findings.title: Inbound webhook endpoint lacks anonymous throttling
findings.disposition: Assigned to 0.9.1 beta defect triage: add bounded endpoint/IP throttling and uniform authentication failure responses.

findings.title: Attachment quarantine is structural validation rather than antivirus
findings.disposition: Assigned to 0.9.5 security remediation: document the boundary and add a maintained antivirus provider behind the existing scanner interface.

findings.title: Base Compose defaults can appear production-ready while remaining development-shaped
findings.disposition: Assigned to 0.9.2 and 0.9.4: make insecure development opt-ins explicit and certify only the production overlay/image combination.

findings.title: OIDC verified-email auto-connect needs an explicit MFA regression
findings.disposition: Assigned to 0.9.1 authentication triage: document trusted issuer constraints and prove enrolled TOTP remains required after identity binding.

findings.title: Backup encryption uses one AES-GCM nonce per artifact stream
findings.disposition: Assigned to 0.9.3 recovery certification: enforce a supported artifact limit or adopt authenticated chunking with counter-derived nonces.
